purpose: Evidence-ready working file for LORE Crypto History.
progress_note: 22 evidence-ready 2022 entries. Remaining research: Otherside gas war, NFT market crash, Super Bowl ads, Harmony hack, FTX wallet drain and selected deep cuts.

entries.title: Ronin bridge exploit drains 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC
entries.summary: Attackers compromised validator keys and drained 173,600 ETH plus 25.5 million USDC from the Ronin bridge; the theft was discovered days later.
entries.significance: The exploit became one of crypto's largest bridge thefts and exposed the security trade-offs behind Axie Infinity's rapidly scaled gaming sidechain.

sources.title: Ronin — The Ronin Bridge Is Open

entries.title: UST loses its dollar peg
entries.summary: Terraform Labs' algorithmic stablecoin UST depegged from the US dollar in May 2022 and entered a collapse with its sister token LUNA.
entries.significance: UST's failure destroyed one of the largest algorithmic stablecoin systems and triggered a wider confidence and credit crisis across crypto.

sources.title: SEC — Terraform and Do Kwon complaint summary
Terraform claims procedures order defining May 2022 second de-peg

entries.title: LUNA hyperinflates and Terra halts its blockchain
entries.summary: As LUNA supply inflated dramatically during the UST failure, Terra validators halted the blockchain at block 7,603,700 to reduce governance-attack risk.
entries.significance: A top-tier blockchain effectively stopped amid its token's death spiral, making the collapse one of the most dramatic failures in crypto history.

sources.title: Terra Research Forum archive of halt announcement

entries.title: Celsius freezes withdrawals
entries.summary: Celsius announced that it was pausing withdrawals, swaps and transfers between accounts, citing extreme market conditions and a need to stabilize liquidity.
entries.significance: The freeze trapped customer funds and became the clearest public sign that crypto's centralized yield/lending model was entering a solvency crisis.

sources.title: The Block quoting Celsius withdrawal pause

entries.title: Three Arrows Capital collapses into liquidation
entries.summary: Three Arrows Capital entered liquidation proceedings in the British Virgin Islands after failing to meet major creditor obligations and filed for Chapter 15 protection in New York on 1 July.
entries.significance: 3AC's collapse turned the Terra shock into a broad institutional credit contagion affecting Voyager, Genesis, BlockFi and other lenders.

entries.title: Voyager Digital files for Chapter 11
entries.summary: Voyager filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions after disclosing a claim of more than $650 million against Three Arrows Capital.
entries.significance: Voyager showed the direct transmission of 3AC's failure into retail-facing crypto lenders and made the 2022 contagion chain visible.

entries.title: US Treasury sanctions Tornado Cash
entries.summary: OFAC added Tornado Cash and associated addresses to the SDN list on 8 August 2022.
entries.significance: The designation created a landmark conflict over sanctions, privacy software, smart contracts and whether decentralized code can be treated like a sanctionable service.

entries.title: Ethereum completes The Merge
entries.summary: Ethereum Mainnet merged with the Beacon Chain and replaced proof-of-work mining with proof-of-stake consensus.
entries.significance: The Merge was one of the largest live consensus migrations in blockchain history and reduced Ethereum's estimated energy consumption by roughly 99.95%.

entries.title: BNB Chain bridge exploit mints two million BNB and triggers network pause
entries.summary: An attacker exploited BSC Token Hub by forging proofs and withdrew two million BNB; validators coordinated a pause to limit the damage.
entries.significance: The incident became a major bridge-security failure and triggered a public debate about BNB Chain's validator concentration and emergency governance.

entries.title: CZ says Binance will liquidate its FTT holdings
entries.summary: Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao said Binance would liquidate remaining FTT received from its earlier FTX equity exit, describing the move as post-exit risk management.
entries.significance: The announcement accelerated scrutiny of FTX and Alameda and became one of the most consequential social-media posts in crypto history.

entries.title: Binance signs a non-binding deal to acquire FTX amid a liquidity crunch
entries.summary: FTX asked Binance for help and the companies announced a non-binding letter of intent for Binance to acquire FTX.com pending due diligence.
entries.significance: The proposed rescue revealed the severity of FTX's liquidity crisis and sent shock waves through global crypto markets.

entries.title: Binance abandons the FTX acquisition
entries.summary: After due diligence and reports of mishandled customer funds and investigations, Binance said it would not pursue the proposed acquisition of FTX.com.
entries.significance: The withdrawal effectively ended FTX's most visible rescue option and made bankruptcy increasingly unavoidable.

entries.title: FTX files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
entries.summary: FTX Trading Ltd. filed a Chapter 11 petition in Delaware on 11 November 2022 as FTX US, Alameda Research and numerous affiliates also entered bankruptcy; Sam Bankman-Fried resigned and John J. Ray III took control.
entries.significance: FTX's collapse was the defining crypto institutional failure of 2022 and exposed severe governance, custody and customer-fund controls across a company once valued in the tens of billions.

entries.title: BlockFi files for Chapter 11 after FTX contagion
entries.summary: BlockFi and eight affiliates filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions on 28 November 2022.
entries.significance: BlockFi's bankruptcy demonstrated how FTX's failure propagated through firms that had previously received financing or support from the exchange.

sources.title: Official Committee of Unsecured Creditors of BlockFi — case timeline

entries.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is arrested in the Bahamas
entries.summary: Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on US charges; the Justice Department unsealed an indictment the following day alleging fraud, money laundering and campaign-finance offenses.
entries.significance: The arrest shifted the FTX story from corporate collapse into one of the largest criminal cases in financial and crypto history.

entries.title: Wormhole bridge exploit mints 120,000 unbacked wETH
entries.summary: An attacker bypassed Wormhole's Solana-side verification logic and minted 120,000 unbacked Wormhole ETH, worth roughly $320-$325 million at the time.
entries.significance: The exploit was one of the largest bridge hacks in history and exposed the systemic risk created when cross-chain bridges mint representations of assets on other networks.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Lessons from the Wormhole Exploit
CertiK — Wormhole Bridge Exploit Incident Analysis

entries.title: Nomad bridge hack becomes a copy-paste free-for-all
entries.summary: A faulty Nomad Replica configuration allowed forged bridge messages to be accepted. More than 300 addresses participated in draining over $186 million after successful exploit transactions were copied.
entries.significance: Nomad became perhaps the purest example of a permissionless on-chain looting event, where the exploit became simple enough for many opportunistic addresses to repeat.

entries.title: Celsius files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
entries.summary: About a month after freezing withdrawals, Celsius and certain subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the Southern District of New York.
entries.significance: The filing confirmed that the withdrawal freeze was a solvency/restructuring crisis rather than a short-lived liquidity interruption.

entries.title: Terra 2.0 launches after the UST/LUNA collapse
entries.summary: After governance proposal 1623 passed, a new Terra chain launched without the old algorithmic stablecoin; the original network became Terra Classic and LUNA became LUNC.
entries.significance: The relaunch was an unusual attempt to preserve a developer ecosystem after one of crypto's largest collapses while leaving the failed stablecoin design behind.

entries.title: Mango Markets is manipulated for roughly $116 million
entries.summary: Avraham Eisenberg used large positions and purchases to drive up MNGO's oracle-reported price, borrowed against the inflated collateral and withdrew roughly $116 million from Mango Markets.
entries.significance: The incident became a landmark case at the boundary between market manipulation, oracle design and 'code is law' arguments in DeFi.

entries.title: STEPN turns move-to-earn into a crypto craze
entries.summary: STEPN's NFT-sneaker fitness app grew rapidly in early 2022; by April BNB Chain highlighted a reported 300,000 daily active users and the project was expanding across app stores and chains.
entries.significance: STEPN extended play-to-earn token economics into real-world movement and became the defining example of the short-lived move-to-earn boom.

entries.title: EthereumPoW launches after The Merge
entries.summary: A group of miners launched EthereumPoW shortly after Ethereum moved to proof of stake, preserving a proof-of-work fork with a new chain ID.
entries.significance: The fork captured the economic displacement of GPU miners after The Merge and tested whether a PoW continuation of Ethereum could retain meaningful users and applications.
